BOOK ONE · LESSON 139

Is that you, John? 是你吗，约翰？

是你吗，约翰？

A dialogue lesson about a telephone conversation between Graham Turner (at his office) and John Smith (the telephone engineer). Graham invites John to dinner this evening at his home with his wife Mary, but John can't come because Mary wants to invite Charlotte and Graham to dinner. Graham wants to know what John is writing about, and John is repairing Graham's telephone line. The lesson introduces tag questions: 'aren't you?', 'do you?', 'is he?', 'are they?', 'won't she?', 'will they?', 'didn't they?', 'has he?', 'wasn't she?'. The workbook drills comprehension questions about the dialogue and tag-question completion; the grammar workbook completes 'will' and 'won't' dialogue items and writes 'if' sentences with 'will'/'won't' and 'may'.

Lesson 课文

Listen to the tape and then answer the question that follows. 听录音，然后回答所接下来的问题。

听录音，然后回答所接下来的问题。

  1. 1

    Graham

    Is that you, John?

    是你吗，约翰？

  2. 2

    John

    Yes, speaking.

    是我，请讲。

  3. 3

    Graham

    Tell Mary we'll be late for dinner this evening.

    告诉玛丽，今天晚上我们吃晚饭要晚到一会儿。

  4. 4

    John

    I'm afraid I don't understand.

    恐怕我不明白您的意思。

  5. 5

    Graham

    Hasn't Mary told you? She invited Charlotte and me to dinner this evening.

    玛丽没有告诉你吗？她邀请夏洛特和我今晚去吃饭。

  6. 6

    Graham

    I said I would be at your house at six o'clock, but the boss wants me to do some extra work.

    我说过六点到你家，但老板要我加班。

  7. 7

    Graham

    I'll have to stay at the office. I don't know when I'll finish.

    我得留在办公室。我不知道什么时候才能做完。

  8. 8

    Graham

    Oh, and by the way, my wife wants to know if Mary needs any help.

    噢，顺便问一下，我妻子想知道玛丽是否需要帮忙。

  9. 9

    John

    I don't know what you're talking about.

    我不知道您在说什么。

  10. 10

    Graham

    That is John Smith, isn't it?

    你是约翰·史密斯，对吗？

  11. 11

    John

    Yes, I'm John Smith.

    是的，我是约翰·史密斯。

  12. 12

    Graham

    You are John Smith, the engineer, aren't you?

    你是工程师约翰·史密斯，对吗？

  13. 13

    John

    That's right.

    是的。

  14. 14

    Graham

    You work for the Overseas Engineering Company, don't you?

    你在海外工程公司工作，对吗？

  15. 15

    John

    No, I don't. I'm John Smith the telephone engineer and I'm repairing your telephone line.

    不，我不在那里工作。我是电话工程师约翰·史密斯，正在修理您的电话线路。

Which John Smith does Graham Turner think he is talking to?

格雷厄姆·特纳以为正在同哪位约翰·史密斯通话？

New words & expressions 生词和短语

telephone engineer
n. phr. 电话工程师
on one's way home
phr. 在回家的路上
repair /rɪˈpeə(r)/
v. 修理
tag question
n. phr. 附加疑问句

Notes on the text 课文注释

tag questions 的用法

附加疑问句由陈述句 + 简短疑问句组成：You are John Smith, aren't you? / You work for the company, don't you?

Is that you? 的用法

「是你吗？」用于电话中确认对方身份：Is that you, John? / Is that Graham?
